system_schema:
Schema for Restaurants
Intent: ReserveRestaurant
required slots: restaurant name,location,time
optional slots: number of seats,date
Intent: FindRestaurants
required slots: category,location
optional slots: price range,has vegetarian options,has seating outdoors
dialog:
User: Will you please help me find a good, reasonably priced place to eat in San Jose?
System: I sure will. What type of food do you prefer?
User: I think I'm in the mood for Cantonese.
System: ApiCall(method='FindRestaurants', parameters={'category': 'Chinese', 'location': 'San Jose', 'price_range': 'moderate'})
Search Results
[{'address': '2033 Camden Avenue # F3', 'category': 'Chinese', 'has_seating_outdoors': 'False', 'has_vegetarian_options': 'True', 'location': 'San Jose', 'phone_number': '408-377-8310', 'price_range': 'moderate', 'rating': '4.30', 'restaurant_name': 'Chef Li'}]
End Search Results
System: In San Jose, I recommend the Chef Li restaurant.
User: Okay. How about some other suggestions?
System: Certainly. Also in San Jose, I recommend China Delight.
User: That's possible. But what else is there?
System: China Station Restaurant is also a good San Jose option.
User: Can you let me know what their user rating is? I'm also wondering if they have seating outdoors.
System: No, they have no outdoor seating, sorry. Their rating is 4.1.
User: Okay, sounds good. Let's book a table for 4 please in the evening 5:30.
System: Confirming a table for 4 on March 1st at 5:30 pm at the China Station Restaurant in San Jose.
User: Okay, sounds like you got it all!
System: ApiCall(method='ReserveRestaurant', parameters={'date': '2019-03-01', 'location': 'San Jose', 'number_of_seats': '4', 'restaurant_name': 'China Station Restaurant', 'time': '17:30'})
Search Results
[{'address': '80 Senter Road', 'category': 'Chinese', 'date': '2019-03-01', 'has_seating_outdoors': 'False', 'has_vegetarian_options': 'True', 'location': 'San Jose', 'number_of_seats': '4', 'phone_number': '408-225-9101', 'price_range': 'moderate', 'rating': '4.10', 'restaurant_name': 'China Station Restaurant', 'time': '17:00'}]
End Search Results
System: Great. The table has been booked.
User: Thanks for all your help today.
System: My pleasure. May I do anything else for you?
Last User Utterance:I don't think so. Thanks again.
Last System Utterance: You are very welcome, of course.
